de.abas.ceks.jedp.session

Interface BlockingActionMessageSource

  • All Known Subinterfaces:
    EDPEditor, EDPQuery, EDPServerAction, EDPSession

    public interface BlockingActionMessageSource
    Interface for all classes which can provide blocking action messagses (BlockingActionMessage). These classes have to implement methods to register and unregister instances of BlockingActionMessageListener.
    Since:
    abas Version 2018r4, EDP Version 3.52

    • Method Detail

      • registerBlockingActionMessageListener

        void registerBlockingActionMessageListener(BlockingActionMessageListener listener)
        Registers a BlockingActionMessageListener for blocking action server messages.

        Parameters:
        listener - an instance of BlockingActionMessageListener
        See Also:
        BlockingActionMessageListener

      • unregisterBlockingActionMessageListener

        BlockingActionMessageListener unregisterBlockingActionMessageListener(BlockingActionMessageListener listener)
        Discards registration of a BlockingActionMessageListener. It will no longer receive blocking action messages.
        Parameters:
        listener - BlockingActionMessageListener to be unregistered
        Returns:
        the instance of BlockingActionMessageListener which has been unregistered or null if none was registered

      • getBlockingActionMessageListeners

        Collection<BlockingActionMessageListener> getBlockingActionMessageListeners()
        Returns an unmodifiable collection of all registered blocking action listeners.
        Returns:
        the list of currently registered listeners.

      • unregisterAllBlockingActionMessageListeners

        void unregisterAllBlockingActionMessageListeners()
        Removes all registered listeners.
